notes: The prompt self-declares Casual Strategy / Auto-Battler, and casual there is an adjective rather than Party & Casual, whose minigames-and-rounds-in-a-lobby pattern this does not have, so Strategy alone. The answers put the build at true miniature scale with players placing figurines from an overhead tabletop view, so nobody walks on it: P0 plus SET, build the diorama and its pieces and skip traversal and jump-gap checks. board-grid over set-display because the 6-by-6 grid is the play surface being acted on rather than a subject framed to be looked at, and tile-grid carries the board itself including the pre-battle placement halves — I did not take buildzone-grid, whose wording assumes a lane this game has none of. Deciding without a user: one board theme is loaded per match, so this is a single board rather than three co-existing maps and no P4 is needed, and the volcano, cluttered-desktop and floating-island themes are dressing on that one grid.
